The Spartan World Championship weekend will include a variety of different World Championship races. A select group of top elites will battle for the 3K Elite World Championship title, while Elite and Age Group racers looking for a more grueling challenge will take on the qualification-based 21K Beast Championships.

programme.title: UIPM 2025 Obstacle World Championships
programme.desc: Beijing’s Olympic Centre turns into a proving ground as the UIPM Obstacle World Championships crown new stars across the 400 m, 3 K, and blistering 100 m sprint.

programme.title: International Temiscamingue Raid Eng
programme.desc: The International Temiscamingue Raid is the first stage event to be part of the Adventure Race World Series, an international series that specializes in adventure races and which brings together the best endurance athletes in the world. Last September, athletes from Brazil, Uruguay, Mexico, Finland and Canada and seven local teams from Temiscamingue participated in the Raid Témiscamingue.

programme.title: Hokkaido Japan by bike - Part 3 Eng
programme.desc: Our bikepacker friend Michele is exploring the Japanese island of Hokkaido. On the agenda: volcanoes, forests, wilderness, brown bears, fishing owls, the Pacific Ocean, and weather that isnt always kind. Episode 3.

programme.title: Spartan Super World Championship 2025 Eng
programme.desc: High in Californias Sierra Nevada, the world gathers for a new test of endurance. This is the Spartan Super World Championship 2025, hosted by Mammoth Lakes, California. A race that starts at 2,400 metres above sea level and climbs higher still. Every athlete knows what waits ahead. 11 kilometres, 26 obstacles and the full force of the mountain.

programme.title: 12th Longines Equestrian Beijing Masters 2025
programme.desc: China. Beijing. A city where history breathes through every stone and shimmer of steel. Here, where dynasties once rode across vast plains, a new kind of cavalry takes the stage riders of precision, courage, and grace. Each autumn, the National Stadium, the Bird’s Nest transforms. Where Olympic legends once soared, hooves now thunder. This is the Longines Beijing Masters — the heart of Asian equestrian sport, and a meeting place for the world’s finest.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: The Road Ahead
programme.desc: Fredrik Erixon, a passionate adventurer crosses Sweden on roller skis from the north in Karesuando in Lappland, to Smygehuk in Skane in the south – a solo journey of about 2000 km over thirty days - representing one Vasaloppet a day (most famous cross country ski race). He rolls across the Arctic Polar Circle, meets interesting people and examines his own motivation in challenging himself and pushing his comfort zone.

programme.title: The Outdoor Sports Show 2025 - Christmas Special Edition
programme.desc: We start this episode from Romania. In our previous episodes, we covered the exciting 2025 edition of Brasov Running Festival, highlighting the effort of the Elite 10k athletes. However, the Brasov Running Festival is much more than just the elite competitors. We then shift our focus to cycling, moving on to Turkey for another edition of LÉtape Türkiye by Tour de France. Moving from Turkey, we catch a flight to Croatia for Spartan Trail Dubrovnik. Since this is the last episode of the TV Show for 2025, we also got a glimpse of some of the most notable moments we enjoyed over the previous months.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben
programme.desc: «The higher you raise the bar the further you fall down!”. Michi language is made of very strong, singular sentences, as sharpened as his climbing style. His sentences try to define himself, without worrying about himself, by thwarting clichés… but do not succeed in really finding himself. On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.

programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn 2025
programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn is a 7-day, 800km full-service gravel stage race through South Africa’s diverse landscapes. Starting in coastal forests, the route heads into the breathtaking Great Karoo – a vast, spectacular semi-desert region. Riders rest each night in remote ‘Burn Camps’ under star-filled skies and, on the final day, greeted by Africa’s iconic Big 5 wildlife.

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Men 2026
programme.desc: Australia’s greatest cycling race is back to launch the international cycling season. South Australia is celebrated at its best, taking the peloton across 6 stages. The 2026 Santos Tour Down Under mens race features a tough climb - Knotts Hill. Each stage pays homage to the events history while exploring great landscapes, promising thrilling challenges for the riders.

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Men 2026
programme.desc: Australia’s greatest cycling race is back to launch the international cycling season. South Australia is celebrated at its best, taking the peloton across 6 stages. The 2026 Santos Tour Down Under mens race features a tough climb - Knotts Hill. Each stage pays homage to the events history while exploring great landscapes, promising thrilling challenges for the riders.

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Women 2026
programme.desc: 9th edition of the Womens Tour Down Under, which is the part of the 2026 UCI Womens World Tour.

programme.title: 2025 Aus Cycling MTB Enduro National Championships
programme.desc: A rain-soaked Collie, Western Australia, becomes the stage for Australia’s premier Enduro showdown, where world-class Wambenger Trails and the iconic Wellington Dam mural frame a weekend of grit, flow and community. Across Juniors, Masters, Adaptive and E-bike fields, riders wrestle slick rock, pea gravel and long liaison climbs as stories of resilience emerge. The result is a kinetic, human-centred portrait of Australian MTB: fast, muddy, inclusive, and unforgettable.

programme.title: Skoda Titan Desert Almeria 2025
programme.desc: Four intense days of mountain biking through Almería’s stunning landscapes — from coast to desert, across sand, hills, and rugged trails. Amateurs and pros alike face the heat, the wind, and their own limits. More than a race, it’s an adventure of endurance, camaraderie, and pure adrenaline beyond the stopwatch.

programme.title: Race to the Rock
programme.desc: The Race to the Rock is an annual unsupported ultra-distance bicycle race through the Australian Outback organized by Jesse Carlsson. Unlike stage races, such as the Tour De France, ultra-distance races start and run continuously until the competitors finish the race, forcing them to make such strategic choices as whether it would be better to take time to eat or sleep, or to sacrifice those things and press on. Race to the Rock is an unsupported race, which means that racers are not permitted to draft or to obtain help from anything other than publicly available sources that are available for all. The course varies every year, but finishes at Uluru, also known as Ayers Rock, and has been so gruelling that only a very small percentage of the competitors have ever finished the race. Roads are mostly unsealed, with limited water supplies, and stretches of 400-500 kilometres at times with no food resupply available.

programme.title: Inside Desertus Bikus Eng
programme.desc: Josh partcipates to Desertus Bikus, an ultra cycling race that crosses Spain and Portugal starting in Hasparren in the Basque Country and finishing in Setubal Portugal. Josh is cycling during 1400 km across desert areas, villages, gravel tracks and asphalt roads.

programme.title: Skoda Titan Desert Almeria 2025
programme.desc: Four intense days of mountain biking through Almería’s stunning landscapes — from coast to desert, across sand, hills, and rugged trails. Amateurs and pros alike face the heat, the wind, and their own limits. More than a race, it’s an adventure of endurance, camaraderie, and pure adrenaline beyond the stopwatch.

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2025 - Episode 12
programme.desc: In our previous episode Italy was on the spotlight. The world’s top WingFoil racers were building up towards the most important event of the season, the first ever Formula Wing World Championships. We also attended Dutch Water Week, that is the premier celebration of sport and water in Netherlands. We will start this episode from Brazil where the Wingfoil Racing World Cup roared back to life on Brazil’s north-east coast, launching its season finale. We will also travel to Turkey, where the Bosphorus turned into a sea of color and pride as the 6th Presidential International Yacht Races concluded with its grand finale. Leaving action aside, we will travel to Malta for for the Malta Boat Show.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Dakhla - Morocco 2025
programme.desc: A full roster of 28 men and 16 women, from a total of 16 countries around the world, are set to join the line-up in Dakhla for five days of intense action that could have a key bearing on who takes the titles. Reigning world champions, France’s Capucine Delannoy and Brazil’s Gabriel Benetton, top the Kite-Surf rankings as they head to the season’s penultimate stop in Dakhla, Morocco, on the Sahara desert’s coastline.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: GKA Hydrofoil Big Air World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: Moana Waiwai - The Film
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai or The Great Ocean in Maori, is about the FreeSwim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she swims 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline over three days to raise awareness for the protection of New Zealands oceans. It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: 2025 ROLEX New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup
programme.desc: Twenty teams from 12 countries would compete in the ninth Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup, the biennial regatta hosted by the New York Yacht Club Harbour Court in Newport, R.I. Since the event was first run in 2009, it has attracted top amateur sailors from 51 of the world’s most prestigious yacht clubs from 23 countries.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: Taíba, Brazil, host the final stop of the GKA Kite World Tour 2025. The world’s top riders will take to Taíba’s powerful Atlantic waves for four days of action-packed competition that will determine the men’s and women’s world titles. The event marks the thrilling conclusion to a season that has already visited Cape Verde, Dakhla, and Sylt.

programme.title: One Water Race 2025 - The Film Eng
programme.desc: One Water Race is an endurance race based on Running, Swimming and Orienteering. 10 mixed teams of 4 athletes have to cross the Stockholm-Sweden archipelago from North to South in a non-stop 250 km race with 200 km of running and 50 km of swimming. They have to completely handle their navigation including in the darkness.

programme.title: All The Way Eng
programme.desc: From award-winning documentary filmmaker Carl Eneroth at Sthlm Social Innovation Lab comes "All the Way". A heart-pounding, intimate and mind expanding portrait of Swimrun team Pontus Lindberg and George Bjälkemo, as they prepare for their ultimate challenge… winning the 75 km ÖtillÖ Swimrun World Championships in the Stockholm archipelago… in trail shoes and a wetsuit.

programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata in the Julian Alps Eng
programme.desc: Just about an hours drive from Ljubljana airport, Prisojnik, or Prisank as its also called is a beautiful 2,547m mountain in Slovenias Julian Alps.This one-day via Ferrata route is a must-do since it presents an excellent hiking and climbing challenge, but also offers all of the views youd even want. To get to its summit Cris and Viv hiked, scrambled, climbed, and even crawled on their stomachs at points, but the views in the end and the feeling of satisfaction that came after made it all worthwhile.

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
programme.desc: The Dark Peak Fell Runners base themselves in Sheffield, but their playground is the Peak District National Park where they weave tracks through the fields, peat bogs and rocky outcrops to create a tapestry of eccentricity, endeavour and endurance. As one of the biggest pure fell running clubs in the UK, the ‘Dark Peak Fell Runners’ captures the personality, quirks and successes of the club and its members. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Aussie 8
programme.desc: Aussie 8 is the adventure of 3 friends who decided to climb the 8 tallest mountains in 8 Australian states in 8 days. To make this possible, they had to put together and respect a very strict timing and logistic organisation.

programme.title: Grand Teton Loop Eng
programme.desc: Grand Teton National Park is a stunning and iconic park in the US, known for its majestic Teton Range, beautiful lakes, and diverse wildlife. In July of 2022, Jeff and Audrée made a stop on their way back to Canada while on a road trip to Colorado, so that they could run a 38 mile / 62 km loop around the park, which mile for mile would be one of the most scenic and beautiful routes theyve ever run.

programme.title: A Feather in the West
programme.desc: In September 2019, a team of talented Irish climbers [Chloe Condron, Kevin Kilroy, Michelle OLoughlin and Conor McGovern] travelled to the small island of Owey to explore sea cliffs that local guidebook writer Iain Miller claims, have “enough new routing potential to last at least twelve lifetimes”. ‘A Feather in the West’ is a film about their trad climbing experiences and the relatively niche pursuit of first ascents, set on the Wild Atlantic Way, off the west coast of County Donegal. (Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Summiting Mt Sneffels in Colorado Eng
programme.desc: Mount Sneffels is a prominent mountain near Ouray, Colorado in the United States which is over 14,000 feet high, more than 4,300 metres. Audree had never climbed a 14er, so we decided to try reach its summit while on a road trip through Colorado in late-July.

programme.title: Alone And Without A Guide On Mexico s Third Highest Mountain-Iztaccihuatl Eng
programme.desc: Being alone and without a guide in a summit attempt for the third highest mountain in Mexico was a dream. The climb is amazing. The ridge to Iztaccihuatls summit feels endless, but the views of the surrounding valleys and Popocatepetl make the effort worth it.

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2025
programme.desc: The World Rookie Tour is excited that the Freeski Finals are held in the magnificent Ursus Snowpark at Madonna di Campiglio. This event shows the world’s most talented young freeski athletes as they compete in one of the most celebrated snowparks in Europe. This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers.

programme.title: Climbing Skye s Highest Peak - Sgurr Alasdair
programme.desc: Cris and Viv decided to climb Sgurr Alasdair, the highest mountain on the island of Skye, located in an area of the mountain range known as Black Cullin. The main challenge they had in climbing the peak was the Great Stone Chute. A 300-meter slope of the harshest mountain terrain - scree. The summit of Sgurr Alasdair has unobstructed views of all of the Munroes in the Black Cullin, and also of one of Skyes most famous routes - The Cullin Ridge traverse.

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Ultra Vegans
programme.desc: For endurance athletes, getting the right diet can make the difference between success and failure. Many are now choosing to adopt a plant based regime and they are witnessing some remarkable results in terms of performance and recovery. Athletes, fitness coaches, sports nutritionists, ultra runners are sharing with us their experience and conviction wether they are motivated by self performance or animal wellfare.

programme.title: Golden Trail World Series 2025 Season Recap - Unfinished Business Eng
programme.desc: This exclusive episode offers fans a fresh and emotional look back at the season, featuring the most thrilling moments, behind-the-scenes insights, and never-before-seen interviews with the athletes who defined the year.

programme.title: X-out Montenegro Eng
programme.desc: X-out Montenegro is part of the Xtri World Tour. Athletes starts with a 1.7 km open-water course. The race is started by the Xekutioner, a formidable figure who will be responsible for future eliminations. 15 of athletes will be eliminated by the Xekutioner, intensifying the competition. Eliminated athletes are given a time penatly and can then try to catch “The Splitter” to ovetake backmarkers and get back in the race! Then a tough and demanding 40 km asphalt cycle which climbs the famous serpentine above Kotor. Designed to test endurance to the max. Another 15 of athletes are eliminated by the Xekutioner here, ensuring only the toughest stay. Finally 6.5 km of downhill trail running and 2.5 km of “vertical” monster climbing. Again eliminated athletes have the opportunity to catch the leaders.

programme.title: Raid Gallaecia 2025
programme.desc: In the frontier between Galicia and northern Portugal, adventure racing returned to one of Europe’s most unspoiled regions with Raid Gallaecia 2025. Over five days and nearly 500 kilometers, 28 international teams battled mountains, forests, rivers, and exhaustion in a non-stop race of strategy, endurance, and teamwork.

programme.title: Norcha Eng
programme.desc: Norcha is more than a race — it’s a journey into the heart of human endurance. Set against the breathtaking landscapes of northern Portugal, Norcha follows teams of adventurers as they leave their comfort zones and confront a challenge designed to push the very limits of body and mind. Trekking, kayaking, mountain biking, rappelling — every stage forces competitors to adapt, to endure, and to discover new depths of resilience. But Norcha is not just about competition. It is about connection — with teammates, with nature, and with the spirit of exploration itself. Guided by values of solidarity, humility, and dedication, this odyssey reveals that the greatest victories are not only measured at the finish line, but in the moments of transformation along the way.

programme.title: Trans Sahara Marathon 2025
programme.desc: The Trans Sahara Marathon. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Sahara Desert, this epic race, held in February 2025, challenges runners to traverse 150 kilometers across four grueling stages of unforgiving terrain. Drawing the worlds top athletes from every corner of the globe, the Trans Sahara Marathon is more than just a race; its a testament to the boundless limits of human potential and the relentless pursuit of greatness.

programme.title: New Zealand 9
programme.desc: In a race against time, three adventurers will set a new speed record by completing New Zealand’s nine Great Walks faster than they’ve ever been done before, using human power alone. It’s the ultimate adventure race. They’ll kayak 145 km, ride 80 km and run over 300 km in just nine days.

programme.title: Challenge Family 2025 - Season Wrap Up Eng
programme.desc: Since its founding, the Challenge Family triathlon series has redefined the spirit of endurance sports. Known for its unique courses, passionate community, and athlete-centered values, Challenge Family offers races in some of the world’s most iconic locations. From the breathtaking landscapes to the demands of each event, Challenge Family is about more than just competition. It’s about athletes pushing beyond their limits, fueled by the support of fans, family, and each other. Through the journeys of athletes, everyone can understand what it takes to prepare, to overcome, and to race with a purpose that goes far beyond the finish line.

programme.title: Trail Menorca Cami De Cavalls 2025
programme.desc: Welcome to a new edition of the Trail Menorca Camí de Cavalls Conecta Balear. 185 kilometers tracing the edge of a millennia-old island, blessed with unique natural beauty. Enchanted trails, towering cliffs, and dreamlike beaches shape one of the most demanding routes in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Changing Channels
programme.desc: Gerrard Gosens is set to become the first totally blind person to attempt the daunting 34+ km swim from Dover in the UK to Cape Gris-Nez in France. Battling the cold and unpredictable waters of the English Channel, Gerrard faces not only the rough conditions but also the need to swim in synchronization with his team of guide swimmers, Hayden, Phil, Jo, Rosie, Alexis, and Sarah by his side.

programme.title: Oman Downwinder Eng
programme.desc: The Oman Downwinder movie intents to show Oman and its conditions for wind powered sports. It is a movie that explores behaviours, the Omani hospitality, the landscape and attractions of Oman within the downwinder route and not, exclusively, a movie about kitesufing/Wingfoiling. The movie was designed to explore the experience of professional kiteboarders/wingfoilers (Ambassadors) interacting with amateur riders based in Oman on this 7-day trip along the coast. Apart from the Ambassadors, the movie also explores the Oman Kitesurfing community via local actors and their experiences during the downwinder.

programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: 2025 ROLEX New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup
programme.desc: Twenty teams from 12 countries would compete in the ninth Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup, the biennial regatta hosted by the New York Yacht Club Harbour Court in Newport, R.I. Since the event was first run in 2009, it has attracted top amateur sailors from 51 of the world’s most prestigious yacht clubs from 23 countries.

programme.title: Hannibal Buress Goes to Scotland
programme.desc: Here is comedian and actor Hannibal Buress as he is filmed on stage and during his trip to Scotland in this docu-film.

programme.title: Todd Rexx "Beautiful Mess" Comedy Special
programme.desc: Here is comedian Todd Rexx's "Beautiful Mess" Comedy Special.

programme.title: z-Marcus D. Wiley's "The Church Shoe Fits"
programme.desc: Marcus D. Wiley's comedy special titled The Church Shoe Fits.

programme.title: Not Another Black Movie
programme.desc: Not Another Black Movie stars Damon Williams (Bad Boys of Comedy, Comic View, BET LIVE, The Tom Joyner Morning Show), Janet Hubert (The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air), Rodney Perry (The Monique Show, Who's Got Jokes) Jay Davis (Not Another Zombie Movie, Shots Fired), and Leon Rogers (WGCI, Comic View, Bad Boys of Comedy). - Not Another Black Movie is not only a spoof of a genre often associated with Tyler Perry films, but a satirical look at family dysfunction as well. Written by Jay Davis and Directed by Donte "Diesel" Williams, Not Another Black Movie addresses issues that effect many families whether they be rich or poor, black or white. Although we poke fun at some of the stereotypical roles portrayed in this genre, we hope to shed some light on problems that plague many families while giving you a good laugh.

programme.desc: Op het punt van een epische roadtrip bezoekt Jonathan het heiligdom van de motorfietsgod voor een zegen en maakt hij een omweg om het volledig vrouwelijke eenheid van de Delhi-politie te ontmoeten.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1
programme.desc: De eilandstaat met 7.000 eilanden heeft geen gebrek aan strand, zon of zee – maar kampt met een hardnekkig imagoprobleem als het om de keuken gaat. Jonathan landt in Manila en ontdekt al snel dat de topchefs zich maar al te goed bewust zijn van dit probleem. Op hun advies vertrekt hij op expeditie om een deel van de oplossing te vinden. De reis voert hem van dorpen van voormalige koppensnellers, via koloniale stadjes waar de tijd heeft stilgestaan, tot restaurants in de schaduw van het Amerikaanse militaire machtsblok. Gaandeweg ontvouwt zich een intrigerend verhaal. In de dichte jungle blijft het ene geheim begraven, terwijl het andere letterlijk uit het houtwerk tevoorschijn komt. Maar het gevaar is nooit ver weg… zombie-achtige murenen, aardverschuivingsgevoelige bergpassen en verboden velden achter de rijstvelden.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1
programme.desc: Finland is dat ene Noordse land dat zelden op de wereldkaart van de gastronomie verschijnt. Maar terwijl niemand keek, hebben de terughoudende Finnen stilletjes hun wildplukcultuur verfijnd en verweven in een unieke keuken. Jonathan Legg doorkruist het hele land om de Finse gastronomie te doorgronden – en de filosofie van de beste chefs te begrijpen. Van verbluffende gerechten met lokale ingrediënten in Helsinki tot een expeditie in Lapland om alles te leren over wildplukken en de Finse delicatesse: rendier!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1
programme.sub-title: Philippines: Why is Filipino food unpopular?
programme.desc: Liesel begint aan een reis naar het land met meer dan 7000 eilanden, de Filippijnen. Van rustig tot louche, ze doorzoekt Metro Manilla op zoek naar eten. Dit culinaire spectrum omvat het afstruinen van populaire fastfoodrestaurants, ontmoetingen met lokale experts zoals blogger Cheryl Tiu, een stukje geschiedenis proeven in 's werelds oudste Chinatown, een onverwachte danssessie in de Spaanse kroegen van Manilla en het ontmoeten van de elite van de chef-koks van de stad. Dit alles in een zoektocht naar het antwoord op de vraag waarom de Filipijnse keuken zo onbekend is!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1
programme.sub-title: Thailand: US Thai Food vs Authentic-Thai, which is the winner?
programme.desc: Amerikanen zijn gewend aan Thais eten, maar wat je op het vasteland van Thailand krijgt, is heel anders dan wat je in een lokale Thaise eettent in Californië krijgt. Wat is beter? Liesel gaat in Bangkok op zoek naar de essentie van wat echt Thais eten is... Heeft Amerika de authentieke Thaise kookstijl aangepast aan de Amerikaanse smaak? Of heeft Thailand de authentieke en minder bekende kruiden, specerijen en technieken in handen die nooit naar Amerika zijn overgewaaid? Origineel of een internationale variant? Liesel snuffelt rond in toeristische wijken, interviewt buitenlanders, proeft ontbijt in drukke buurtcafés en natuurlijk zou het Thailand niet zijn zonder een insecten-eetavontuur! Een kijkje op een iconische boerenmarkt die alleen voor de lokale bevolking is, zet Liesel aan om moeilijk te vinden Thaise ingrediënten te zoeken die misschien niet naar Amerika zijn overgewaaid. Is dit de reden waarom Thaise gerechten in de VS zo anders smaken dan in Thailand?

programme.title: Travel Quest S1

programme.desc: Als er ooit een enorme astroïde de aarde in gevaar brengt, kunnen de particuliere ruimtevaartbedrijven en hun geavanceerde, herbruikbare ruimtevaartuigen ons dan redden?

programme.title: Space Greed S1
programme.desc: In deze aflevering onderzoeken we alle manieren waarop oorlogen in de ruimte kunnen worden uitgevochten en wie er een aardig centje kan verdienen aan de ontwikkeling van ruimtewapens.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1
programme.desc: Het verhaal van de wetenschap achter de grootste, geavanceerdste en duurste telescoop ooit gemaakt.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1
programme.sub-title: First Images: The James Webb Telescope
programme.desc: Een nieuw tijdperk in de sterrenkunde is aangebroken nu de wereld voor het eerst de volledige capaciteiten van NASA's James Webb-ruimtetelescoop kan zien. De eerste beelden van 's werelds grootste en krachtigste ruimtetelescoop tonen Webb in zijn volle potentie.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1
programme.desc: Dit is een kijkje in NASA's baanbrekende Artemis-programma, het ruimteschip en de mensen die de mensheid een stap dichter bij de maan, Mars en verder zullen brengen.

programme.title: Rethink S1
programme.desc: We leggen uit hoe ambigrammen je brein voor de gek houden, ontdekken de grootvaderparadox en het vraagstuk rond tijdreizen. Tot slot testen we je gehoor met de Shepard Tone-illusie.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1
programme.sub-title: A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle
programme.desc: In de Cabot-fabriek in Pennsylvania, VS, wordt een blok staal door innovatie en vakmanschap omgevormd tot de ultieme update van een Amerikaanse klassieker. De 1911 heeft dienst gedaan in beide wereldoorlogen en in Vietnam, en wordt vandaag de dag nog steeds gewaardeerd door verzamelaars en liefhebbers.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1
programme.sub-title: A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher
programme.desc: Een gevechtstank is slechts zo effectief als zijn wapen, en bij de Stryker is dat het M68 105mm-kanon. Een gesmeed stalen buis wordt gehamerd tot een van de krachtigste kanonnen uit de moderne oorlogsvoering.

programme.title: Science of Sound S1
programme.desc: Professionele atleten gebruiken muziek om zich op te peppen voor een grote wedstrijd, maar waarom kan muziek ons inspireren, motiveren en aan het huilen maken?

programme.title: Science of Sound S1
programme.desc: Marty Music onderzoekt samen met dr. Michael Oliver, neurowetenschapper aan de Belmont University, hoe live muziek onze hersenen beïnvloedt.

programme.title: Past, Present, Future S1
programme.desc: Grote landbouwbedrijven produceren voedsel voor de massa met één kanttekening: ze zijn rampzalig voor het milieu.

programme.title: Past, Present, Future S1
programme.desc: Komedie is altijd al een manier geweest om de wereld om ons heen te verklaren. Tegenwoordig krijgen cabaretiers programma's omdat ze corrupte politici ter verantwoording roepen.

programme.title: VR 101 S1
programme.desc: Kunnen studenten gewoon een VR-headset opzetten en vanuit hun eigen huis naar college gaan? In deze aflevering bekijken we enkele van de nieuwste VR-apps voor educatie, en VR-games voor na het leren.

programme.title: VR 101 S1
programme.desc: VR kan worden ingezet voor praktische doeleinden zoals trainingen en verkeersveiligheid, maar juist die zintuiglijke overbelasting kan leiden tot beoordelingsfouten in het echte leven.

programme.title: VR 101 S1
programme.desc: VR kan worden ingezet voor praktische doeleinden zoals trainingen en verkeersveiligheid, maar juist die zintuiglijke overbelasting kan leiden tot beoordelingsfouten in het echte leven.

programme.title: Combat Countdown S1
programme.desc: Of de strijd nu te land, ter zee of in de lucht is, elke oorlogsmachine heeft vermogen nodig. Bij luchtgevechten op 15 kilometer hoogte of enorme ladingen tillen is PK de beslissende factor.

programme.title: Combat Countdown S1
programme.desc: Of de strijd nu te land, ter zee of in de lucht is, elke oorlogsmachine heeft vermogen nodig. Bij luchtgevechten op 15 kilometer hoogte of enorme ladingen tillen is PK de beslissende factor.

programme.title: Combat Countdown S1
programme.desc: Snelle informatie is belangrijk voor de aanval en verdediging. Waar de slag ook gevoerd wordt, het is essentieel de vijand eerder te zien dat diegene jou ziet.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1
programme.desc: Sportstadions worden wereldwijd erkend als zeer aantrekkelijke architectonische schatten. Onze top tien maakt duidelijk dat de meest fantastische stadions niet alleen voor voetbal of honkbal zijn, maar ook voor zwemmen of atletiek. De architecten van deze juweeltjes wisten dat het ontwerp uniek en monumentaal moest zijn.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1
programme.desc: Dave hijst een airco-unit voor een collegegebouw en een historische attractie, Brad en Nathan trotseren de wind bij het hijsen van spanten, en Dan en Francis draaien een nachtdienst ondergronds.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1
programme.desc: Brad en Nathan bouwen een brandweertrainingsunit, Dave werkt aan attracties en Dan en Francis tillen een enorme graafmachine uit een bouwput.

programme.title: The Ship Sinkers
programme.desc: Wat is het lot van schepen die ooit trotse vaartuigen in de haven waren, maar nu zijn verworden tot drijvende schroothopen? Eén mogelijkheid is om ze te slopen en het metaal te recyclen. Maar er is ook een alternatief: ze inzetten om de mariene biodiversiteit te bevorderen door ze te transformeren tot kunstmatige riffen. Oude marineschepen worden door speciale teams – zogenoemde ship sinkers – tot zinken gebracht en vinden zo hun laatste rustplaats op de zeebodem.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1
programme.desc: Ultimate Explosions brengt de meeslepende verhalen van explosies die wereldwijd voelbaar waren.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1
programme.desc: Verken de hightech, razendsnelle wereld van auto- en motorraces.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1
programme.desc: Een fascinerende kijk op de radicale concepten en innovatieve ideeën die treinen sneller, veiliger en steeds futuristischer maken.

programme.title: How Things Work S1
programme.desc: Skateboard, stofzuiger, pinautomaat, krik, digitale projector en multitool... Met ultrarealistische CGI-animatie laten we alledaagse objecten uiteen vallen in hun onderdelen om hun geheime werking te onthullen.

programme.title: How Things Work S1
programme.desc: Loopband, platenspeler, barbecue, buitenboordmotor, pneumatische boor en balpen... Met ultrarealistische CGI-animatie laten we alledaagse objecten uiteen vallen in hun onderdelen om hun geheime werking te onthullen.

programme.title: How Things Work S1
programme.desc: Crosstrainer, 3D-printer, keukenmixer, frozen-yoghurtmachine, tourniquet en bureaustoel... Met ultrarealistische CGI-animatie laten we alledaagse objecten uiteenvallen in hun onderdelen om hun geheime werking te onthullen.

programme.title: Disruptive Behaviour
programme.desc: Reuben Christian reist naar Istanbul om de innovators te ontmoeten die de stad veranderen en te ontdekken hoe technologie de oude orde verstoort.

programme.title: The Aviators S2
programme.desc: Het jaarlijkse evenement van de Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association. We nemen je mee naar de luchteenheid van de Los Angeles Police Department om te zien hoe 's werelds grootste politievloot helpt boeven te vangen en Jeff praat met Red Bull Air Racer Pete McLeod over het leven als een high-adrenaline, competitieve vlieger.

programme.title: The Aviators S2
programme.desc: Een kijkje op een van de meest zorgvuldig onderhouden grasbanen waar dan ook op wat we ontdekten als een puur toevluchtsoord voor liefhebbers van de luchtvaart en het buitenleven. Allemaal aan boord van Fat Albert Airlines, de ongelooflijke USMC C130T van de Blue Angels en Sara ontmoet Peyton McCool en maakt een ritje (letterlijk) in zijn trainer uit het Sovjettijdperk.

programme.title: The Aviators S2
programme.desc: Twintig piloten nemen deel aan de grondschool voor de T33 Silverstar, maar slechts één van hen wint een kans om er daadwerkelijk mee te vliegen. We bezoeken het Joe Nall-evenement, de “Oshkosh” van het RC-vliegen, en Raeleen gaat vliegen met de rocksterren van het airshowcircuit, het Aeroshell Aerobatic Team.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1
programme.desc: Ga mee op een reis door het iconische geluid van de beroemdste Porsche-motoren.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1
programme.desc: Bekijk het eerste deel van een reportage over de tweede editie van een prijsuitreiking voor duurzaamheidsprojecten die de wereld kunnen veranderen.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1
programme.desc: Bekijk het tweede deel van een reportage over de tweede editie van een prijsuitreiking voor duurzaamheidsprojecten die de wereld kunnen veranderen.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Monsters S1
programme.desc: 1800 meter hoog in de Rocky Mountains van Colorado ligt de Colewyo kolenmijn. Deze pleke produceert een ijzingwekkende 2,3 miljoen ton steenkool per jaar om de Craig energiecentrale te voorzien van de brandstof die nodig is om 1300 megawatt elektriciteit te leveren aan het Tri-State gebied.

programme.title: Power & S2
programme.desc: Jean Yves Blondeau is de uitvinder van het rollerpak met 32 woelen, waarmee de drager met een snelheid van tot 112 km/uur in allerlei houdingen van een heuvel kan racen.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1
programme.desc: Brad en Nathan bouwen een brandweertrainingsunit, Dave werkt aan attracties en Dan en Francis tillen een enorme graafmachine uit een bouwput.

programme.title: Health Explored S1
programme.desc: Ontdek hoe deze diepgewortelde Japanse traditie van bosbaden zowel fysieke als psychologische voordelen biedt, je geest opent en je zintuigen afstemt op de therapeutische krachten van de natuur.

programme.title: Health Explored S1
programme.desc: We leren over ikigai, de bestaansreden die zo fundamenteel is voor het leven in Okinawa. We bezoeken tuinders, spelen gateball en ontmoeten een oudere dame die wordt geprezen om haar vitaliteit tijdens de beroemde Miss Kitanakagusku-wedstrijd.

programme.title: Health Explored S1
programme.desc: Heb je ooit gewandeld met je oren, neus en tong? We leren over de oude praktijk van Shin Rin Yoku of bosbaden aan de rand van de grootste stad ter wereld.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1
programme.desc: Francesca Chiorando is in het VK om elektrisch gitaarmakers Crimson Guitars en de iconische fabriek van Marshall Amplification in Milton Keynes te bezoeken.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1
programme.desc: Francesca Chiorando gaat de racebaan op voor een testritje in een van de snelste raceauto's ter wereld; een handgemaakte Prodrive Aston Martin.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1
programme.desc: In deze aflevering neemt Francesca Chiorando een kijkje in de grootste tractorfabriek van het VK om te zien hoe zij hun nieuwste tractor op maat bouwen.

programme.title: Sci Q S1
programme.desc: Een populaire wetenschapsshow die je wetenschappelijke intellect op de proef stelt. Vliegen vliegende eekhoorns écht? Wat veroorzaakte het uitsterven van dinosaurussen? Hoe oud zijn de fossielen op de bodem van de Grand Canyon?

programme.title: Sci Q S1
programme.desc: Een populaire wetenschapsshow die je wetenschappelijke kennis test. Hoe slim is een robot tegenwoordig? Hoe komt het dat de aarde een dampkring heeft? Waarom zijn er in de Verenigde Staten meer tornado's dan elders?

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1
programme.desc: Presentatrice Emily Calandrelli gaat in gesprek met wetenschappers over de eerstvolgende bestemming in ons zonnestelsel: Mars.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1
programme.desc: Presentatrice Emily Calandrelli bezoekt het Johnson Space Center om uit te leggen wat er voor nodig is om astronaut te worden.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1
programme.desc: Presentator Joe Penna onderzoekt hoe designers naar pijlstaartroggen kijken om de manier van diepzeeverkenning in de oceaan te veranderen.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1
programme.desc: Presentator Joe Penna neemt je mee terwijl hij praat met astronauten, ontwerpers en fabrieksarbeiders terwijl ze beschrijven hoe de robotrevolutie hun manier van werken verandert.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5
programme.desc: In deze aflevering duiken we met tientallen stierhaaien in Fiji. Daarna gaan we naar Zuid-Florida om inheemse mangroves aan te planten in een gebied waar dat nodig is. De reis eindigt met een reis naar Maui.

programme.desc: Physicist and rock star, Buckaroo Banzai must save the world from the evil Red Lectroids.

programme.title: Bandits

programme.title: Hackers

programme.title: Stargate

programme.title: Rollerball (1975)
programme.desc: In a dystopian future, a brutal sport takes the place of war, and murder is part of the game!

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: In the ravaged near-future, bikers brutalize Max's family, sending him into a mad frenzy for revenge!

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.

programme.title: American Ninja
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

programme.title: American Ninja 2: The Confrontation
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

programme.title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
programme.desc: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

programme.title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

programme.title: Walking Tall (2004)
programme.desc: When it comes to laying down the law, one man can make a difference! Action superstar Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson takes no prisoners as he fights for justice and crushes corruption in this story of one man who takes a stand and takes back his town!

programme.title: Red Corner
programme.desc: In this provocative thriller, an American (Richard Gere) on a business trip in China is framed for a brutal murder and soon finds himself at the mercy of a foreign court system he doesn't understand. Can he find the true killer before it's too late?

programme.title: Rolling Thunder
programme.desc: William Devane and Tommy Lee Jones star as two former P.O.W.s out for revenge in this neo-noir action-thriller that Quentin Tarantino cites as one of his favorite films. Written by genre masters Paul Schrader and Heywood Gould. John Flynn directs.

programme.title: Eye Of The Needle
programme.desc: Donald Sutherland stars in this moody thriller as a villainous Nazi spy whose passions betray him via a married woman (Kate Nelligan) in this intriguing blend of romance and espionage against the backdrop of WWII Britain.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: The Battle Of Britain (1969)
programme.desc: A stellar cast, including Michael Caine, Laurence Olivier and Christopher Plummer highlights this epic telling of the greatest air battle in history, when the outnumbered Royal Air Force defeated the German Luftwaffe, saving England from invasion.

programme.title: The Great Escape
programme.desc: Steve McQueen, James Garner and Richard Attenborough headline a stellar cast in one of the most ingenious and suspenseful adventure films of all time as a team of Allied soldiers mount a daring escape from an "inescapable" Nazi POW camp.

programme.title: The Great Escape
programme.desc: Steve McQueen, James Garner and Richard Attenborough headline a stellar cast in one of the most ingenious and suspenseful adventure films of all time as a team of Allied soldiers mount a daring escape from an "inescapable" Nazi POW camp.

programme.title: A Bridge Too Far
programme.desc: With an all-star cast that includes Sean Connery, Anthony Hopkins, Laurence Olivier, Gene Hackman and Robert Redford, this epic WW II drama recreates Operation Market Garden, an ambitious plan to hasten the end of WW II that ended in disaster.

programme.title: Valkyrie
programme.desc: Based on the true story of Colonel Claus von Stauffenberg (Tom Cruise) and his assassination plot targeting Adolph Hitler, this engrossing thriller reenacts the daring operation to eliminate one of the most evil tyrants the world has ever known.

programme.title: Windtalkers
programme.desc: John Woo directs this epic, action-packed drama about a WW II soldier (Nicolas Cage) assigned to protect a Navajo soldier (Adam Beach)...and the secret code he knows. Christian Slater, Roger Willie, Peter Stormare and Mark Ruffalo also star.

programme.title: Flesh + Blood
programme.desc: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

programme.title: Rob Roy
programme.desc: Liam Neeson and Jessica Lange give extraordinary performances as the legendary hero who refused to let his enemies destroy his honor and the loyal woman who gave him the courage to fight! Tim Roth, in an Oscar®-nominated performance, also stars.

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

programme.title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
programme.desc: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

programme.title: Navy Seals
programme.desc: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

programme.title: Shor In The City
programme.desc: A film set in Mumbai, India. The movie revolves around the lives of three men who get caught up in the chaos of the city. The first story follows two small-time crooks who attempt to pull off a heist. The second story focuses on a struggling cricketer who gets caught up in a web of corruption. The third story is about a young couple trying to find their way in the chaotic city. As their lives intersect, they must navigate through the noisy and bustling streets of Mumbai to find their own paths.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: The movie follows an insomniac office worker who befriends a charismatic soap salesman, and together they start an underground fight club as a way to cope with their mundane lives. As the club gains popularity, they become involved in a larger plan to undermine the consumerist society they live in.

programme.title: Baghban
programme.desc: It tells the story of Raj and Pooja, a couple married for 40 years, who are forced to live apart after retirement when their four sons refuse to care for them together.

programme.title: Khuda Kasam The Challenge
programme.desc: CBI officer Neetu Singh is framed for the assassination of a chief minister. She attempts to solve this murder mystery with the help of a man who is sentenced to prison for a crime he never committed.

programme.title: Gumnaam The Mystery
programme.desc: An aspiring actress, Ria who models and acts in music videos is offered a lead role in a film by casting director Rishi Gandhi. However, when she arrives at the director's mansion, she begins to realise that things are not as they seem.

programme.title: Mangal Pandey (the Rising)
programme.desc: It is the year 1857. The British are plundering the resources of their Indian subjects, who have reached their breaking point. Soldier Mangal Pandey (Aamir Khan) leads an uprising against India's imperialist occupiers -- events the British call a mutiny and the Indians call a war for independence. Throughout the violent events, Mangal maintains a friendship with Capt. William Gordon (Toby Stephens), who sympathizes with India's subjugated citizens and obeys his conscience.

programme.title: Hema Malini Parveen Babi Hit Bollywood Divas
programme.desc: The Original Bollywood Divas! Hema's elegance + Parveen's sass = Unbeatable 70s magic. Press play for nostalgia in every note!

programme.title: Dance Hits
programme.desc: Pure nostalgia on the dance floor! Celebrate the vibrant sounds of old-school Hindi dance music with timeless beats and retro charm.

programme.title: Shahenshah Of Bollywood-83rd Birthday Special Vol 2
programme.desc: Iconic melodies of Amitabh Bachchan reflecting romance,pride, and cinematic brilliance.

programme.title: Zindagi Ka Safar
programme.desc: Dive into the emotions of life, with a collection of heartfelt songs that beautifully capture the highs and lows of life. Let these timeless tunes resonate with your emotions and experiences.

programme.title: Dilip Kumar – Tributes To A Legend
programme.desc: Celebrate the voice of a generation with songs immortalized by the charisma of Dilip Kumar. Soul-stirring ghazals, patriotic numbers, and emotional ballads that reflect a cinematic titan’s journey.

programme.title: Masti Bhare Geet
programme.desc: Feel-good songs to groove to. Perfect for boosting your mood and adding fun to any moment – pure, carefree energy!

programme.title: Blissful Beats

programme.title: Time and Tide
programme.desc: 400-year-old Matsue Castle retains its original keep, a National Treasure. Black and imposing, it stands like a battleship. Why did the lord build such an enormous keep on such a small site?

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history and culture. This episode looks at words related to the morning. Japanese people cherish the subtle changes in nature, and they have been particularly fond of the quiet hours in the early morning. The moment of sunrise alone has produced many beautiful expressions. Poet, literary translator, and long-time Japan resident Peter MacMillan guides us through unique words and the culture behind them.

programme.title: MATSURI: The Heartbeat of Japan
programme.desc: Kawanishi Dainenbutsu Kenbai is an elegant and dynamic dance, accompanied by flutes and taiko drums. In 2022, it was registered as UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, and it even takes place at a World Heritage Site: Chusonji in Hiraizumi, Iwate Prefecture. The dance retells a story from 900 years ago, when the Buddha, in the form of a monkey, guided restless souls to the Pure Land. We meet local people who are working hard to keep the tradition alive.

programme.desc: In The Whistleblowers, former CIA agent John Kiriakou brings you some of the bravest men and women fighting for justice. programme.title: CrossTalk
programme.desc: CrossTalk is a TV debate experience which presents hot-topic discussions on politics, business, newsmakers, global trends, present-day conflicts, and dangers and challenges facing our world. Host Peter Lavelle poses hard, straightforward questions to his guests, and demands concrete answers in response.

programme.title: Documentary
programme.desc: RT's documentaries give a varied and unique view on different aspects of life worldwide. They expose outdated myths and stereotypes, reveal intriguing history and geography, showcase varied wildlife and exquisite cuisines, introduce you to vibrant nightlife and curious customs. Original footage of historical events and sharp analysis of contemporary politics will give you a deeper understanding of what made history take this or that turn. RT's documentaries go beyond the bare facts, thoroughly investigating the issues and giving the viewer a chance to see below the surface.
